raw_segments.text: He was in John Henry Menton's, and then he went round to Collie's and Ward's, and then
Tom Rockford met him and sent him round to the subsurf's for a lark.
Oh God, I have a pain laughing.
The Longfellow gave him an eye as good as a process, and now the bloody old lunatic
is gone round to Green Street to look for a G-Man.
